title: Director, Legal, Commercial & Procurement Lead
description:
Zenoti provides an all-in-one, cloud-based software solution for the beauty and wellness industry. Our solution allows users to seamlessly manage every aspect of the business in a comprehensive mobile solution: online appointment bookings, POS, CRM, employee management, inventory management, built-in marketing programs and more. Zenoti helps clients streamline their systems and reduce costs, while simultaneously improving customer retention and spending. Our platform is engineered for reliability and scale and harnesses the power of enterprise-level technology for businesses of all sizes

Zenoti powers more than 30,000 salons, spas, medspas and fitness studios in over 50 countries. This includes a vast portfolio of global brands, such as European Wax Center, Hand & Stone, Massage Heights, Rush Hair & Beauty, Sono Bello, Profile by Sanford, Hair Cuttery, CorePower Yoga and TONI&GUY.

Our recent accomplishments include surpassing a $1 billion unicorn valuation, being named Next Tech Titan by GeekWire, raising an $80 million investment from TPG, ranking as the 316th fastest-growing company in North America on Deloitte's 2020 Technology Fast 500™. We are also proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work CertifiedTM for 2021-2022 as this reaffirms our commitment to empowering people to feel good and find their greatness. To learn more about Zenoti visit: https://www.zenoti.com

**About the Role**
==================

Zenoti is hiring a Senior Counsel / Director, Legal in India to own commercial, procurement and product legal work for a global SaaS and fintech platform serving the salon, spa, wellness and fitness industries. You will partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Compliance, Security and Finance, and support colleagues across time zones. The role reports to the General Counsel.

**Role**
========

* Collaborate with the sales team to develop efficient processes that accelerate deal closures while maintaining rigorous legal standards.
* Negotiate vendor contracts and ensure that Zenoti and its customers are protected.
* Negotiate customer and partnership deals in collaboration with the global sales organization.
* Oversee the management and maintenance of all company legal templates, including our Order Forms, MSA, Privacy Policy, Partner Agreements, DPA, BAA.
* Stay up to date on changes in laws and regulations impacting the business and communicate to appropriate parties any changes to controls, policies and procedures.
* Evaluate risk factors impacting business decisions and anticipate unique legal issues that could impact Zenoti.
* Communicate and negotiate with external parties, creating relationships based on trust.
* Willingness to roll up their sleeves and take on tasks both big and small. A collaborative approach with a low ego in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
* Strong sense of ownership, desire to make a cross-functional impact, eagerness to learn, and customer orientation.
* Address other ad-hoc or specialized legal issues.

**Product Counseling**
======================

In addition to the responsibilities above, you will be the legal partner to Product and Engineering, involved from concept through launch.

* Embed with product teams in roadmap planning, PRD and design reviews, and launch readiness. Spot legal issues early and turn them into clear product requirements, not just legal opinions.
* Advise on payments and fintech features, including payment processing and facilitation models, card network and acquirer rules, prepaid and stored-value programs, and relationships with sponsor banks and payment partners. Assess licensing, money transmission, BSA/AML, sanctions, PCI DSS, NACHA, UDAAP and consumer disclosure requirements, working closely with the Chief Compliance Officer and compliance team.
* Counsel on consumer-facing SaaS features used by our customers' clients, including online booking, memberships and recurring billing (auto-renewal and negative-option laws), gift cards and loyalty, reviews, and SMS and email marketing (TCPA, CAN-SPAM, CASL, carrier messaging rules).
* Advise on AI and machine learning features, including data use and model training rights, output ownership, transparency and human-oversight requirements, and emerging AI regulation (for example the EU AI Act and U.S. state laws).
* Draft and maintain product-specific legal documents: product terms, in-product disclosures and consents, acceptable use and API terms, and partner, marketplace and integration agreements.
* Review platform and third-party terms, including app store rules and age-verification or parental-consent laws, open-source license compliance, and AI and other vendor terms embedded in the product.
* Review product marketing and advertising claims, including comparative claims and claims about security, compliance and AI capabilities.
* Support product security and privacy incident response, and customer security and compliance questionnaires, together with InfoSec.
* Build scalable, self-service tools (playbooks, checklists, templates and intake workflows) so a small team can handle a high volume of product requests without becoming a bottleneck.
* Track new and changing laws that affect product design, and translate them into practical guidance for Product, Engineering and Sales.

**Requirements**
================

* LLB and LLM degrees from an accredited school with 5+ years of experience negotiating SaaS agreements.
* Direct experience with a variety of legal matters, including complex commercial agreements, healthcare, payment processing, privacy documents (e.g., BAA, DPA), information security and compliance.
* Strong negotiating skills with both legal and commercial matters.
* Strong track record of building and maintaining cross-functional relationships, with adaptable communication styles that strike the right balance between business risk-taking and safeguarding organizational interests.
* Willingness to support colleagues across a range of time zones.
* 5+ years of product counseling experience at a SaaS or technology company, advising product and engineering teams in an agile environment.
* Working knowledge of fintech and payments law, such as card network rules, PCI DSS, money transmission and licensing, BSA/AML and sanctions, UDAAP and consumer disclosure rules. Direct experience with a payments, embedded finance or prepaid product is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of privacy and data-protection laws that apply to SaaS products (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, India's DPDP Act, HIPAA) and of emerging AI regulation.
* Working knowledge of consumer-protection and marketing laws that affect product features, including auto-renewal, TCPA and CAN-SPAM.
* Experience drafting product terms, in-product disclosures and consents, and API or partner terms.
* Ability to turn legal and regulatory requirements into practical product guidance, and to give clear, risk-based advice to non-lawyers at speed.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* In-house experience at a fintech, embedded payments or vertical SaaS company, including work with payment processors, sponsor banks or card programs.
* Experience counseling on AI-enabled product features.
* Healthcare IT or HIPAA experience.
* Privacy or technology-law certification, such as CIPP/E, CIPP/US, CIPM or AIGP.
* Experience supporting U.S.-based product and sales teams from India.

*Zenoti provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.**This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.*

title: Legal Manager – Commercial & PMRC
description:
At Azurity, we're redefining medicine for the real world. Most medicines are designed for how they're approved; ours are built for real life. That shift drives everything we do. We challenge the status quo — repurposing proven molecules with intention, reimagininghow therapies are designed, delivered, and accessed so they work in the realities of everyday life. And with a diversified and growing portfolio, we bring the agility, scale, and global reach to deliver meaningful solutions to patients, providers, and healthcare systems around the world. Because medicine should fit into life, not force life to fit around it. With more than 70 medicines across 11 therapeutic areas, Azurity's mission is fueled by a growing portfolio that reaches millions of people in more than 50 countries. Learn more at www.azurity.com and LinkedIn.

Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.

**About the Role**

Azurity's Legal team supports a growing portfolio of pharmaceutical products in the U.S. and globally. We are seeking a dynamic, commercially oriented attorney to serve as a key legal resource for promotional review and commercial activities, partnering closely with Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, Compliance, and other cross-functional stakeholders to support compliant product promotion and commercialization.

**Principal Responsibilities**

* Serve as a primary legal reviewer in Azurity's Promotional Materials Review Committee (PMRC/MLR) process, reviewing U.S. and global promotional and non-promotional materials and advising on applicable legal and compliance requirements.
* Provide legal advice on prescription and over-the-counter pharmaceutical advertising, promotional messaging and activities, including sales and speaker materials, digital and social media, training materials, scientific communications, disease awareness materials, patient support materials, payor materials, and advisory board materials.
* Partner with Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, Compliance, and other stakeholders to advise on compliant commercial strategies, brand plans, campaigns, and tactics, including appropriate claims, messaging, and supporting materials.
* Help oversee and continuously improve the PMRC/MLR review process, including workflows, governance, escalation pathways, consistency of review, and development of practical guidance and best practices.
* Proactively identify, analyze, and assess legal and compliance risks relating to Azurity products and commercial activities, including risks arising under applicable U.S. and global pharmaceutical advertising and promotional requirements.
* Draft, review, and negotiate commercial agreements, including marketing, sales and commercial operations agreements, statements of work, consulting arrangements, and change orders.
* Provide legal support on other commercial, compliance, and cross-functional matters as needed.

**Qualifications and Education Requirements**

* LL.B. / LL.M. from a recognized college or university, with approximately 5+ years of post-qualification legal experience, including at least 2+ years of experience supporting pharmaceutical promotional/MLR review for products marketed in the U.S.
* Demonstrated experience reviewing pharmaceutical promotional and non-promotional materials and advising Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, and Compliance stakeholders.
* Strong working knowledge of U.S. pharmaceutical laws, regulations, and industry requirements, including the Anti-Kickback Statute, False Claims Act, HIPAA, and Sunshine Act, as applicable to pharmaceutical commercial activities.
* Familiarity with FDA requirements and principles governing prescription drug advertising and promotion, including claims, fair balance, substantiation, and scientific communications.
* Experience with or knowledge of global pharmaceutical advertising and promotional requirements strongly preferred.
* Experience with Vodori or a similar pharmaceutical promotional review and approval platform preferred.
* Experience supporting innovator and/or 505(b)(2) pharmaceutical products preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide practical, business-oriented legal guidance and work effectively with stakeholders across geographies and functions.

By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

title: Tax Analyst, Federal Compliance & Reporting, Tax Provision Technology
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Amazon Tax department is a fast-paced, team-focused and dynamic environment. Amazon is seeking a Tax Analyst to join our Federal Tax Reporting and Compliance team with experience in process improvements and data analytics to help deliver support surrounding US Federal income tax filings and the US Federal elements of Amazon’s worldwide tax provision.  
  
This role will be part of a specialized team driving the delivery of solutions to standardize, optimize and transform tax processes that will scale as the business grows. You will help define the right models, tools and mechanisms necessary to address business opportunities, drive automation, improve controllership and earn trust across the tax organization. Amazon has a culture of being builders and you will get to use the latest technology and internal Amazon tools to help scale big and fast.  
  
The ideal candidate will have demonstrated great attention to detail, a proven track record of building and improving complex financial models, effective written and verbal communication skills and a strong desire to continuously learn and invent. You must be a fast learner who can quickly understand Amazon's data structure. You need to be analytical in decision-making with ability to drive issues to completion.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Perform hands-on data delivery, detailed data research and analysis of large-scale, complex financial data sets; investigate, troubleshoot and resolve issues related to data
* Collaborate with customer teams to identify opportunities for improving efficiency and controllership in current processes to eliminate manual efforts within the US Federal Tax Return and worldwide tax provision
* Drive process improvements and coordinate with the Tax Technology team to facilitate streamlining and automation
* Develop tax models for various tax calculations and review tools through the creation of end-to-end scalable processes by leveraging technology.
* Preparation and review of tax adjustments, audit-ready workpapers and federal tax returns for US reporting
* Stay up-to-date on tax law and organizational impact of those changes

  
About the team  
The Federal Reporting and Compliance team manages Amazon's worldwide taxable income calculations and federal tax obligations. We own the full lifecycle of federal tax provision and compliance, including worldwide taxable income calculations for quarterly closes, forecasts, and annual returns. While collaborating with specialist teams on areas like stock compensation, R&D credits, and TCJA provisions, we drive technological innovation and process improvements to enhance efficiency and controllership in our deliverables. Our work directly impacts Amazon's global tax provision and US federal income tax reporting.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, business or related field
* 2+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
* Knowledge of at least one data-focused technology tool, such as Python, SQL, Alteryx, Amazon QuickSight, or similar
* Knowledge of strong understanding of tax compliance principles, regulations, and reporting requirements across jurisdictions
* Experience with Corptax tax return and provision preparation or equivalent software
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
* Experience working in a large public accounting firm or multi-national corporate tax department

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* CPA
* Passion for process, data and efficiencies
* Positive mindset, strong professionalism, sound judgment and an insatiable intellectual curiosity

title: Senior Product Compliance & Risk Manager - India
description:
**Company Description**

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money. Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money. For everyone, everywhere.

More about our mission and what we offer.

 **Job Description**

The Product Compliance & Risk (PC&R) team sits at the centre of Wise’s product development function, supporting our cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional compliant-by-design products for our customers.

We’re seeking a highly motivated, customer-centric individual to join our team to leverage their deep understanding of India regulatory requirements and expectations to launch new products, grow our presence and manage compliance risks in India.

This hands-on first line of defence (1LOD) role will involve working closely with product teams in APAC and globally to ensure our controls strike the right balance between meeting compliance requirements whilst maximising customer experience.

**This is a hands-on role, with high levels of ownership over:**

* Designing and continuously improving our products and controls: Leverage your deep understanding of the Wise product and regulatory requirements and risks to support new product launches. This includes communicating requirements in clear, practical terms, and taking a risk-based, scalable approach with the customer experience front-of-mind when designing, uplifting and implementing controls.
* Regulatory and financial crime risk management: Stay ahead of trends and the regulatory agenda in India, identify, assess and present risks quantitatively and qualitatively in clear and understandable terms, and work collaboratively to define and execute on risk mitigation plans.
* Regulatory change and remediation: Conduct regulatory gap analyses, define and scope actions to remediate gaps, and ensure implementation plans are executed in a timely manner. Collaborate with global teams to identify synergies with programs of work already completed or underway across the Wise Group, and ensure Wise Product teams are aware of the most recent regulations and guidance.
* External engagements: Represent Wise through external engagements such as audits and regulatory inspections, including explaining and defending our controls, and developing and executing remediation plans.

**This role will give you the opportunity to:**

* Grow your hands-on Fintech knowledge at full speed, with high levels of ownership and autonomy.
* Collaborate with our amazing teams both locally and globally to build state-of-the-art products for our customers that are compliant-by-design.
* Be empowered to identify problems and opportunities, and take a lead in the solution design and implementation.

**About you:**

* Expert in regulatory and financial crime compliance and risk management in India, with 10+ years experience in financial services (banking, fintech or consulting) and a deep understanding of the expectations of local regulators/policymakers.
* High levels of ownership and autonomy, with the ability to proactively identify improvement opportunities or areas of elevated risk, prioritise, and drive work from inception to completion at pace with limited oversight. This includes anticipating risks and roadblocks, and demonstrating resilience to work through them.
* Problem solving attitude, with the ability to not only analyse and interpret complex regulatory and risk management frameworks, but to exercise sound judgement in proposing and implementing customer-centric and scalable solutions, using data to drive decision-making and quantify risks.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to effectively interact with different audiences (from Product & Engineering teams to external auditors and regulators such as the RBI).
* Strong collaboration skills, to work effectively with different stakeholders globally (such as Product, Risk and Compliance), and to influence without authority.
* Challenge the status quo, thinking outside-the-box and questioning how we can achieve an optimal balance of achieving compliance whilst delivering the best outcomes for our customers.
* Previous experience working directly with product and engineering teams, including effectively translating regulations into actionable business requirements.
* Willingness to travel, as Wise offices are located across different countries.
* Legally authorised to work in India or Singapore.

**Nice to have but not essential:**

* Previous experience in working in a fintech or a similar fast-paced environment.
* Previous experience working with a PA-CB and/or ADII licensee.
* Experience working in cross-border teams.

 **Additional Information**

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

title: Company Secretary
description:
**Job Title: Company Secretary**

**Job Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated **Company Secretary** to join our organization. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in **corporate governance, statutory compliance, legal and regulatory requirements, cost management, and board administration**.

The Company Secretary will work closely with the **Board of Directors, senior management, shareholders, regulators, auditors, and external legal advisers** to ensure that the organization operates efficiently, transparently, and in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Corporate Governance \& Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with all applicable statutory, regulatory, and corporate governance requirements.
* Maintain and update the company's statutory books, registers, records, and corporate documents.
* Monitor changes in legislation and regulatory requirements and ensure timely implementation of necessary actions.
* Ensure company policies and governance frameworks are current, compliant, and appropriately approved.
* Develop and implement processes and systems to strengthen compliance and organizational governance.

**Board \& Shareholder Management**

* Coordinate and manage Board of Directors, Board Committee, and Annual General Meeting (AGM) processes.
* Prepare meeting agendas, notices, board papers, presentations, and supporting documentation.
* Attend meetings and prepare accurate minutes, resolutions, and action points.
* Maintain proper records of Board and shareholder decisions and ensure timely follow\-up on agreed actions.
* Manage communications with shareholders and other key stakeholders.

**Legal \& Regulatory Liaison**

* Provide appropriate legal, governance, and regulatory guidance to the Board and senior management.
* Liaise with external legal counsel, auditors, regulators, government authorities, and other professional advisers.
* Ensure timely submission of statutory returns, filings, disclosures, and regulatory reports.
* Support the organization in managing corporate legal and regulatory matters.

**Cost Management \& Financial Oversight**

* Monitor and manage corporate governance, compliance, legal, secretarial, and administrative costs.
* Develop and monitor budgets related to the Company Secretarial and corporate governance functions.
* Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency without compromising compliance or governance standards.
* Review professional fees, regulatory expenses, consultancy costs, and other related expenditures.
* Work with Finance and other departments to monitor expenses against approved budgets.
* Support management in implementing cost\-control measures and improving operational efficiency.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in law**, Business Administration, Commerce, Finance, or a related discipline**.
* Professional qualification as a **Chartered Secretary / Company Secretary** or equivalent.
* Minimum **8 years of relevant experience** in Company Secretarial, Corporate Governance, Legal Compliance, or a similar role.
* Strong knowledge of corporate governance principles, statutory requirements, and regulatory frameworks.
* Experience in cost management, budgeting, and expense monitoring will be an advantage.
* Strong understanding of Board and shareholder meeting procedures and corporate documentation.

**Key Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong corporate governance and compliance knowledge.
* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Sound legal and commercial understanding.
* Strong stakeholder and relationship\-management abilities.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Budgeting, cost\-control, and financial management awareness.
* Ability to manage confidential and sensitive information with a high level of integrity.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with senior management and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Proficiency in **Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint**.

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹80,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time

* Executive communication

The Senior Compliance Manager – Global Surveillance Oversight (GSO) will serve as the lead surveillance risk management officer for the India\-based Global Surveillance Oversight function, providing strategic leadership, governance, and oversight across multiple surveillance domains, including Trade Surveillance, Electronic Communications Surveillance and Voice Surveillance.


This role is accountable for leading and driving the evolution of India GSO Team. The position requires a highly experienced compliance leader capable of balancing regulatory risk management, operational execution, stakeholder engagement, and transformation initiatives across multiple jurisdictions.


The role will act as a senior partner to global GSO stakeholders, ensuring surveillance frameworks remain effective, scalable, regulator\-ready, and aligned to evolving regulatory expectations.

**Strategic Leadership \& Governance**

* Ensure consistency of surveillance standards, governance frameworks, operating procedures, and escalation protocols across regions.

Lead and oversee GSO activities across:
* Trade Surveillance
* Electronic Communications (E\-Comms) Surveillance
* Voice Surveillance
* Key responsibilities include:

* Identify opportunities to improve effectiveness, efficiency, scalability, and risk coverage through technology and data solutions.

* Build succession pipelines and strengthen technical expertise across the function.
* Promote employee engagement, capability development, and leadership growth.
* Ensure effective capacity \& resource planning, workload prioritization, and performance management.

* Ensure timely identification, escalation, and mitigation of surveillance\-related risks.
